      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_Fork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Fork" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Fork" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="Task_DeliverToGuestRoom"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverToGuestRoom" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" targetRef="Task_PrepareOrDeliverOtherOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${otherOrderPending == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOrDeliverOtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="End_RoomServiceCompleted"/>

  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Start parallel preparation">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholOrdered" name="Alcoholic beverage ordered?" default="Flow_11">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol" name="Fetch wine from cellar and prepare other alcoholic beverages">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Alcohol handling done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Ready to bill">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest's account">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_GuestCallsRoomService" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholOrdered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholOrdered" targetRef="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverToGuestRoom"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverToGuestRoom" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" targetRef="Task_PrepareOrDeliverOtherOrder">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
                  id="Definitions_RoomService"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/evanstonian-room-service">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room Service Order at The Evanstonian" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RoomServiceManager" name="Room-Service Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_GuestCallsRoomService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveOrderToSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignOrderToWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier (Wine Waiter)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverToGuestRoom</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OtherOrderPending</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareOrDeliverOtherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_RoomServiceCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestCallsRoomService" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Start parallel preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol" name="Fetch wine from cellar and prepare other alcoholic beverages">
      <bpmn:documentation>About 80 percent of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth and silverware)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Food, wine and cart ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverToGuestRoom" name="Deliver food, wine and cart to guest's room">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Ready to bill">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" name="Other order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_18">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOrDeliverOtherOrder" name="Prepare or deliver other order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest's account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RoomServiceCompleted" name="Room service order billed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_GuestCallsRoomService" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverToGuestRoom"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_DeliverToGuestRoom" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" targetRef="Task_PrepareOrDeliverOtherOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${otherOrderPending == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrderPending" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOrDeliverOtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="End_RoomServiceCompleted"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity is carried out alongside a monitoring or follow-up activity that runs at the same time (joined by 'and' or 'while'), and a later step is reached only after both are finished: Model a parallel gateway that splits into the concurrent activities, and a parallel gateway that joins them before the next step. Do not model the concurrent activities as one sequential chain, and do not add conditions to the branches.
rules.situation: the description states that an activity is performed while other activities are being carried out (joined by 'while' or 'during'), and a later step is described only after all of these activities are complete

rules.instruction: When the description states that several activities are carried out side by side (linked by 'while', 'and', or 'in any order') and a later step may only be reached once all of them are complete: Model each of the side-by-side activities as its own task, each on a separate branch opened by a parallel split gateway. Close all branches with a parallel join gateway before the later step, so the next step waits for every branch. Do not merge the activities into one task or subprocess, do not drop any of them, and do not insert an exclusive gateway or decision condition among the branches.
rules.situation: the description states that several activities are carried out side by side (linked by 'while', 'and', or 'in any order') and a later step may only be reached once all of them are complete
rules.source: learned guideline (refines GW-05), generalized from EXS-022

rules.instruction: When the description says an activity is performed while activities by other actors are still under way, and a later step requires all of these activities to be finished before it starts: Model the activity as a parallel branch that starts at the same point as the other concurrent activities, placed after the step that releases them. Do not serialize it into a sequence with those activities. Join all concurrent branches with a parallel gateway before the dependent step, so the join waits for every branch.
rules.situation: the description says an activity is performed while activities by other actors are still under way, and a later step requires all of these activities to be finished before it starts
